meta.name: Debakanya
meta.description: Debakanya (ଦେବକନ୍ୟା) is an Odia feature film presented by Supreme Entertainment, celebrating the rich cultural heritage, traditions, emotions, and values of Odisha. Directed by Rasesh Mohanty (Silu) and produced by Suresh Kumar Sahu and Bhargabi Tripathy, the film brings together a compelling storyline, powerful performances, soulful music, and captivating visuals. Featuring Subhasish Sharma (Mantu) and a talented ensemble cast, Debakanya offers an engaging cinematic experience rooted in Odia culture and human emotions. Released across India on 20 November 2026, the film reflects Supreme Entertainment's commitment to meaningful storytelling and the growth of Odia cinema.
